io.milvus.v2.service.vector.request

Class FunctionParamValue

  • java.lang.Object
    • io.milvus.v2.service.vector.request.FunctionParamValue

  • public class FunctionParamValue
extends Object
    A typed value used as a function-chain parameter or literal argument.

    Values are converted from ordinary Java objects into the protobuf FunctionParamValue message: Boolean -> bool, integral numbers (Integer/Long/Short/Byte/BigInteger, range-checked) -> int64, floating-point numbers -> double, String/Character -> string, byte[]/char[]/ByteString -> bytes, List -> array, Map -> object.

      • from

        public static FunctionParamValue from(Object value)
        Converts an arbitrary Java object into a FunctionParamValue.

        Supported types mirror PyMilvus's _to_param_value: Boolean, Integer/Long/Short/Byte/BigInteger (range-checked to int64), Float/Double, String/Character, byte[]/char[]/ByteString, List (recursively), and Map (recursively).

        Parameters:
        value - the value to convert
